translations.web: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
translations.bsb: Seek good, not evil, so that you may live. And the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be with you, as you have claimed.
translations.kjv: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
translations.asv: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live; and so Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be with you, as ye say.
